title: Connect Skill discovery and execution to canonical M6 Agent loop
goal: Wire scoped Skill discovery, deterministic selection, capability-preserving proposal, M6 policy and approval handoff, registered execution, and verified observations into the canonical M6 loop.
context: Issue #445. Runtime must remain independent of PASkills; Composition owns the concrete adapter. No-match remains answer-only; missing execution boundaries fail closed.
forbidden_changes: Do not add a PARuntime dependency on PASkills.
Do not treat approval as an implicit grant or report unverified execution as success.
Do not change UI or unrelated runtime behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A registered Skill survives planning, proposal, authorization, execution, and verified observation through M6CompositionRoot.
M6 policy and explicit approval gate run before the concrete Skill executor; capability mismatch fails closed.
Executor output is independently verified before a successful observation is recorded.
No-match preserves answer-only behavior and missing boundary remains fail-closed.
Required CI gates pass; do not claim local tests without running them.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
recovery: If validation fails, fix the same logical change and amend the branch commit; revert the task commit if the security or architecture invariants cannot be preserved.
